name: Launch Control XL3 · Surface
description: DAW Control mode with screen names/values and LEDs. Knobs: macros, per-page row, sound row; faders: filter + amp envelopes; buttons: tone select/on, page jumps, playlist. Sequencer/Live pages: scenes + stop tracks. DAW Mixer button = mixer layer (levels, pans, sends, solo/mute; Track = part bank).
